name: resonate-tools
description: Resonate's test suites. npm test = regress.sh fast (node only, no server, ~4 min); npm run regress = regress.sh main (the browser suites too: start tools/harness/xb/collect-serve.mjs first). The suites require('playwright'): this is the version installed in the sandbox (/opt/node-tools), with its browsers in PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH.
